program_name: Texas Moving Image Industry Incentive Program (MIIP)
stacking_notes: Base grant 5-25% depending on spend. Highly stackable uplifts for rural, veterans, post-production.

program_name: Maryland Film Production Activity Tax Credit

notes: Features specific secondary provisions for small/indie films.

program_name: Virginia Motion Picture Production Tax Credit
stacking_notes: Base 15%. Highly stackable uplifts for distressed areas, VA resident payroll, and first-time employees.
uplift_type: Distressed Area (5%), VA Resident (10-20%), First-Time Emp (10%)
notes: Uplifts apply specific stackable percentages to particular wage or spend pools.

authority: Colorado Office of Film, Television and Media

notes: HB 24-1358 restructured the program.

program_name: Tennessee Film, Entertainment & Music Commission Incentives
stacking_notes: Base 25% discretionary cash grant. Scorecard system can boost to 30%.
notes: Discretionary grant, not a guaranteed tax credit. Includes Music Scoring Grant.

stacking_notes: Base 20% cash rebate. Highly stackable uplifts up to 38% (Rural, TV, Post, Music, Soundstage).
uplift_type: Rural (3%), Soundstage (5%), TV (2-5%), Multi-Film (5%), Post (3%), Music (2%)
notes: Stand-Alone Post-Production Incentive (SAPI) also exists.

stacking_notes: 25% on expenditures, 35% on resident payroll. Small budget provision offers 45% on payroll.
notes: Includes dedicated music funding. Capped annually.

stacking_notes: Base 30% refundable tax credit. 35% if shooting in enhanced county or using resident labor.
notes: Cannot exceed 35% total.

program_name: Alberta Film and Television Tax Credit (FTTC)
stacking_notes: Base 22% for foreign-owned, 30% for AB-owned. Foreign-owned can unlock 30% via rural/remote filming uplift.
notes: Uplift specifically closes the gap for foreign productions.

program_name: Manitoba Film & Video Production Tax Credit | Manitoba Film & Music — Production Support Grants
stacking_notes: Cost of Salaries (up to 65%) or Cost of Production (up to 38%). Very aggressive uplifts.
uplift_type: Frequent Filming (10%), Rural (5%), MB Producer (5%), MB Company (8%)
notes: Stacks with Canadian Federal incentive.

program_name: Nova Scotia Film & Television Production Incentive Fund

uplift_type: Distant Location (10%), Rural (2%), Duration (1%), NS Content (3%)
notes: Separate Screen Nova Scotia Content Creator Fund acts as an additional top-up.
